programs.programName: NC Program of All-Inclusive Care for the Elderly (PACE)

verified.notes: PACE in North Carolina requires age 55+ and nursing-facility level of care; NC Medicaid indicates financial eligibility for long-term care Medicaid/PACE, but a separate countable-asset limit was not clearly published on the retrievable official pages. NC PACE Association states there is no financial barrier for PACE enrollment as long as other criteria are met.
